messages:
elaine: Quick preflight — drafting internal release note + short ops checklist for tomorrow's change window. Pasting the candidate copy below; need eng/ops/PM signoff before I post.

praveen: Skimmed it. A few requests: call out canary % steps explicitly, mention region ordering (us-east first), and make the fallback wording actionable.

sam: Agree with praveen. Also include the exact rollback command and who executes it (oncall).

elaine: Added rollback stanza and canary percentages. What do you think of this condensed snippet?

```text
Release: inference-runtime v2.7.0
When: 2026-04-01 03:00-05:00 UTC (change window)
What's new: improved batching heuristics, KV cache warmup to reduce tail latency (~15% median improvement)
Rollout plan: canary 10% (us-east) -> 50% (multi-region) -> 100% over ~45 minutes; pause points at each step for 10m
Fallback: automatic fallback to pinned stable variant (v2.6.9) if error rate > 1% OR latency regression > 25% for 5m
Actionable ops steps: monitor Console routes /models, Grafana panel "inference/core-latency" and the error-rate alert; be ready to run rollback command below
Rollback (ops): `./deploy --service inference --version v2.6.9 --reason "post-release rollback" --triggered-by @oncall`
Note: model pinning is configured in rollout policy: `model.pin = \"v2.7.0\"`
```

maria: Love the short format. For the internal audience, can we add a "what to expect" bullet with 1-2 customer visible changes and 1 line on expected cost impact? PM wants that.

josh: I added the Grafana link and the runbook pointer in the pinned note draft: https://grafana.company/inference/core-latency and runbook: https://docs.internal/runbooks/inference-rollbacks

sam: Nice. One more ops ask: include the deploy-bot exact scheduled messages so staff know the timeline.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary -> 10% at 2026-04-01T03:10Z (us-east), 50% multiregion at 2026-04-01T03:35Z, full at 2026-04-01T03:55Z. Rollback token: --rollback v2.6.9. Alerts will be sent to #eng-oncall and #product-ops.

maria: Copy-edit suggestion: replace "automatic fallback" with "automatic fallback to pinned stable variant" so it reads less magical for PMs.

praveen: Approved from eng after the pin check. Confirmed `rollout.policy.model.pin = \"v2.7.0\"` is set in staging and mirrored in prod config.

elaine: Great — locking the copy. I'll send the internal blurb at 12:00 PT tomorrow, followed by a short post-release digest once full rollout completes. Ops: please stand by for manual rollback if alerts fire.

praveen: :thumbsup:

maria: :tada: Thanks everyone — will prep the customer-facing microcopy separately.

josh: I'll be on watch during the window and will call for rollback if thresholds hit.

elaine: thanks all — closing this thread and moving the final text into #announce with tags.
